name: attempt_account_unlock
description: attempt_account_unlock: Attempt to unlock a locked user account on a specific system. Returns success if the account was locked and is now unlocked. Returns cannot_unlock_security_hold if the account is under a security investigation or admin hold — in that case the account cannot be unlocked through the service desk. Returns an error if the account is not actually locked.

employee_id.description: The employee whose account should be unlocked (e.g. EMP048271).

target_system.description: The system where the account is locked.
